title: The Covenant and the Breach with Judah
description: The Lord commands Jeremiah to proclaim the words of the covenant to Judah and Jerusalem, reminding them of the curse for those who break it. The people have returned to the sins of their ancestors and burned incense to Baal, and the Lord reveals a conspiracy among the men of Judah. He calls Judah a green olive tree that is now to be set on fire. Finally, a plot against Jeremiah's life by the men of Anathoth, his own hometown, is uncovered, and the Lord announces judgment upon them.
